verdict.rationale: Pendo's Leo assistant lets users ask questions in natural language and take actions such as building guides and segments in the same conversation. It is also surfaced in Slack, Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, with an official MCP connector. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which operations beyond guides and segments can be driven by natural-language commands, independent or hands-on corroboration that the conversational actions work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask questions in natural language and take action by building guides and segments inside the same conversation.
Product intelligence in Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more.
Pendo is available in Claude's official Connectors Directory. Set up the integration directly from Claude, no manual configuration needed.
